{{Quote|That's ''it'', your highness... ''Metalorn!'' Just ''one'' in hundreds of Imperial ''factory planets''.|Rebel Captain|<ref name="SW30" />}}
'''Metalorn''' was an industrial world in the [[Talcene sector/Legends|Talcene sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], between [[Anzat/Legends|Anzat]] and [[Roche system|Roche]]. Once a hot jungle planet, its rich veins of [[Ore/Legends|ore]] attracted heavy industry, and by the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] Metalorn had become a polluted factory world covered with industrial plants, mines and ore refineries. Metalorn was one of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent System's]] most productive industrial planets during the Clone Wars, and under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] became a penal colony for dissidents. The planet was occupied during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] and was heavily [[Terraforming/Legends|Vongformed]], reversing many centuries of pollution and turning it into a prime recruiting ground for the [[Peace Brigade]].

==Description==
At one point, Metalorn was a sun-beaten [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] world where, in the upper atmosphere, it was almost impossible for weaker ships to land because the intense heat would melt them. At the surface, however, were lush tropical forests separated by shallow seas.<ref name="TEGtW-AC" />

Metalorn's rich veins of ore attracted heavy industry in the decades before the Clone Wars, in particular [[Baktoid Combat Automata/Legends|Baktoid]] and the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]]. Metalorn was remade as a factory world covered in plants, refineries and ore-processing centers making everything from security droids for the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] to industrial goods for the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] and [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. The surface became a barren wasteland of rock, ash, and industrial magma pits created by underground city-factories, the rain forests withered and burned, and the planet's shallow seas became irreversibly polluted.<ref name="TEGtW-AC" />

A large area of the planet was dominated by a gigantic refuse pile known as [[the Wasteland]], which held large amounts of trash and junk. Among the only native species that survived industrialization were the [[Chitin/Legends|chitin]]-armored [[Daggerfly|daggerflies]], which fed on the vermin that infested the factory refuse heaps.<ref name="TEGtW-AC" />

==History==
===Clone Wars era===
[[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Foreman/Legends|foreman]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] built a factory on Metalorn which manufactured [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] for the Techno Union's security forces, and later [[C-B3 cortosis battle droid/Legends|C-B3 cortosis battle droids]] for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]' army, using the numerous cortosis ore deposits located within the planet. Under the Techno Union, rivers were converted into canyons so they could move the materials to the factories more easily.

When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted, the planet was part of the [[Foundry of the Confederacy/Legends|Foundry of the Confederacy]], a swath of industrial planets loyal to the Confederacy of Independent Systems (CIS), supplying it with weapons and warships. Because of that, it was a constant target of attacks by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and changed hands several times during the war.<ref name="TEGtW-AC" />

[[File:MetalornOrbit-CWA5.jpg|thumb|left|Metalorn during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]]]

[[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] [[Mission to Metalorn (Clone Wars)|foiled]] the creation of the [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] droids and captured Wat Tambor on Metalorn in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="TNDA">''[[Star Wars: The New Droid Army]]''</ref>

[[19 BBY/Legends|Three years later]], the Techno Union captured [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] and was holding her in a high-security prison, from which no one had ever escaped. After finding out about this, [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] came up with a desperate [[Mission to Metalorn (Bail Organa)|mission]] to save the imprisoned [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] by convincing Wat Tambor that Alderaan wanted to join the Confederacy of Independent Systems and convert Alderaan into a factory world like Metalorn. Tambor was deceived and allowed Organa to land the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] on Metalorn so that he could give the Alderaanian a tour of the factories. During the tour, Bail asked to see the Techno Union's prison facilities. Tambor brought the group to [[Unreal City/Legends|Unreal City]], the prison complex of Metalorn that was so big it could hold twice the population of a normal planet and was visible from orbit. While touring the complex, Bail located Shaak Ti's holding cell and freed her using her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. During the battle that ensued, they escaped in the ''Tantive IV'' and left the planet for good, saying that they had to notify the Galactic Republic and the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] about the atrocities that were going on on Metalorn.

===Imperial era===
Soon after the [[Declaration of a New Order]], a [[Sy Myrthian Insurrection|campaign]] was fought when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] attempted to drive out the [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|holdout]] forces of the CIS led by ex-Senator [[Toonbuck Toora/Legends|Toonbuck Toora]] from the Foundry of the Confederacy. At Metalorn, the Separatists were [[Battle of Metalorn (Imperial Period)|defeated]] by the Imperial [[Twelfth Army/Legends|12th Sector Army]], under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

Under the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], Metalorn was a primary [[Factory world/Legends|industrial world]] of the Galactic Empire under [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Corwyth]]. [[Human/Legends|Human]] laborers wore identical uniforms and were allowed to do little other than work. They were little more than [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]].

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] [[Mission to Metalorn (Galactic Civil War)|infiltrated the world]] and planted the seed of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] in the heart of a young native girl named [[Tammia Hollusen]]. Tammi rebelled against the oppressive Empire by planting a single flower on Metalorn.<ref name="SW30" />

===Later history===
After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Metalorn was integrated into the [[Greater Maldrood]], an Imperial faction established by [[High Admiral]] [[Treuten Teradoc]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was later freed by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="TEGtW-AC" />

Metalorn was conquered and [[Terraforming/Legends|Vongformed]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|attempted conquest]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The invaders' terraforming restored Metalorn's ecology, albeit with a decidedly Yuuzhan Vong flavor, and the planet became a recruiting place for the [[Peace Brigade]]. After the war, former Peace Brigadier Tammia Hollusen became Metalorn's leader. In [[32 ABY/Legends|32 ABY]], Leia Organa Solo returned to Metalorn to discuss a truce with Hollusen.<ref name="TEGtW-AC" />
